card.title: SSD controller circuit current draw troubleshooting via fuse F7520

source.title: PS5 SSD Controller Fuse and Current Measurement

symptoms: current draw in standby of 175 mA and then back to 10Ma

claims.statement: A current draw in standby of 175 mA and then back to 10Ma indicates a potentially bad SSD controller IC.
A good working SSD circuit draws 310mA.

cautions: Remove fuse F7520 that feeds the voltage on the back to the voltage regulator that generates power for the SSD circuit before measuring current.
card.caveats: The image does not specify the exact voltage or standby conditions required to achieve the 310mA reading, other than it being a 'good working SSD circuit'.
